cd /workspace && timeout 300 ruby -e '
require "bcrypt"
require "active_record"
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "postgresql", host: "localhost", database: "consul_development", username: "root", password: "root")

h = row[0]
puts "hash prefix: #{h[0,20]}"
puts "bcrypt match admin: " + BCrypt::Password.new(h).is_a?(BCrypt::Password) + " " + (BCrypt::Password.new(h) == "Aa12345678" ? "TRUE" : "FALSE")
' 2>&1 | tail -3
